title: Check a prime number
question: Check whether 29 is prime using trial division.
code:
n = 29
is_prime = n > 1
for divisor in range(2, int(n ** 0.5) + 1):
    if n % divisor == 0:
        is_prime = False
        break
print(is_prime)
explanation: Only divisors up to the square root need to be checked.
